authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Platts explicitly derives mahtārī “mother” from mahat + tara + ikā. This supplies the feminine formation for Turner’s mahattara elder/great family, whose article also has Marathi mahātārā old and Konkani mhāntāro/mhāntāri old man/woman. The h-bearing survey forms fit this full formation, with internal extraction spaces retained. Short matāī/matārī forms which could mix with mātr are held instead of generalized to this rule.
